stream.connectedHint: Live updates from the server are connected. This is not your phone's registration.
stream.degradedHint: Live updates are interrupted; the page may be showing stale data.

errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.AGENT_REQUIRED: This action works through an agent identity, and this account has none.
errors.AGENT_IMPERSONATION_NOT_ALLOWED: A signed-in account acts as itself.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: This credential does not hold the capability {{requiredScope}}.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields did not pass validation; check each one.
errors.TERMINAL_ANNOUNCE_REQUIRED: This deployment's voice provider says only what it is given, so every phase the call does not leave needs a line of its own.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The endpoint does not take this method.
errors.CONFLICT: That change conflicts with the current state.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.EXTENSION_IN_USE: Another agent is signed in at that extension.
errors.EXTENSION_ASSIGNED_TO_AGENT: An agent has that extension as their phone. Unbind them before deleting it.
errors.NOT_CALL_PARTY: You are not on that call.
errors.AGENT_NOT_IN_WRAP_UP: There is no finished call to file this against.
errors.TRANSCRIPTION_DISABLED: Post-call transcription is not enabled on this deployment
errors.USER_DATA_TOO_LARGE: The call has no room for this business data: at most {{maxKeys}} keys, {{maxValueBytes}} bytes each. Nothing was written.
errors.NUMBER_ON_DNC: That number is on the do-not-call list. No call was placed.
errors.DID_CHANNELS_EXHAUSTED: That DID has reached its outbound line limit. No call was placed.
errors.DID_NOT_OUTBOUND: That number is not allowed to dial out, so it cannot be the caller id. Allow outbound on the number first. No call was placed.
errors.OUTBOUND_NOT_CONFIGURED: This deployment cannot place outbound calls: AICC_OUTBOUND_ENDPOINT is not set. Connect a carrier (deploy/carrier.md), then try again. Nothing was dialled.
errors.CAMPAIGN_FLOW_HAS_TRANSFER: The flow behind this number can hand the caller to a person, and a campaign call has no way to one. Remove the transfer from the flow, or choose another number.
errors.CAMPAIGN_DID_NOT_OUTBOUND: The number this campaign dials from does not allow outbound calls. Allow outbound on the number, or choose another number.
errors.CAMPAIGN_RING_TIMEOUT_TOO_LONG: The ring timeout must be shorter than the 60 seconds a call may take to be answered.
errors.CAMPAIGN_WINDOW_OUTSIDE_LIMIT: The calling window must lie inside the hours this deployment permits for outbound calls.
errors.CAMPAIGN_FIELD_LOCKED: That cannot be changed while the campaign is running, paused or finished.
errors.CAMPAIGN_INVALID_TRANSITION: The campaign is not in a state that allows this.
errors.OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_CALL_TYPE: This kind of call does not offer that.
errors.TRANSFER_IN_PROGRESS: A transfer of this caller is already on its way. Wait for it to complete.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: This would leave nobody able to administer the platform.
errors.EXTENSION_POOL_EXHAUSTED: There are no free extension numbers left in the pool.

rules.DEFAULT_NEEDS_OUTBOUND: Only a number that can place calls can be the default one.
rules.DESTINATION_FORMAT: An extension or a number: digits, with an optional leading +.
rules.DID_HAS_NO_PUBLISHED_FLOW: That number has no published flow.
rules.DIRECTION_REQUIRED: A number must take calls, place them, or both.
rules.EXTENSION_RANGE_INVERTED: The extension range ends before it starts; fix AICC_EXTENSION_RANGE.
rules.FLOW_REQUIRED: A number callers can reach needs the flow it answers with.
rules.INVALID_TIME: Use HH:MM, with 24:00 allowed as an end.
rules.LANGUAGE_SUBTAG: A lowercase language tag of at most 8 characters, such as en, zh or pt-br.
rules.NAME_CHARSET: No spaces, @, quotes or any of \ ^ , | { } $.
rules.NOT_BELOW_ANSWER_WINDOW: Must be shorter than the 60-second answer window.
rules.NUMBER_INVALID: That is not a phone number the platform can read.
rules.OUTSIDE_PERMITTED_HOURS: Outside the hours this deployment permits.
rules.PHONE_INVALID: Digits only, 2 to 32 of them, with an optional leading +.
rules.PHONE_TAKEN: That phone number already has a contact.
rules.SLUG_CHARSET: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
rules.SOUND_EXPANSION: A sound may name a variable such as $${hold_music}, and nothing else in ${…}.
rules.TARGET_CHARSET: No spaces, quotes or any of \ ^ , | { } $.
rules.TIME_ZONE_INVALID: Not a known time zone name, for example Asia/Shanghai.
rules.TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows in one request.
rules.UNKNOWN_OVERFLOW_TYPE: Pick one of the listed overflow types.
rules.UNKNOWN_ROLE: Pick one of the listed roles.
rules.UNKNOWN_STATUS: Pick one of the listed statuses.
rules.UNKNOWN_STRATEGY: Pick one of the listed strategies.
rules.USERNAME_CHARSET: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.

agent.signInPrompt: Sign in at a phone to take calls.
agent.dialPlaced: Dialing — your phone will connect first.
agent.noQueuesStaffed: You are not on any queue, so queued calls are not offered to you.
agent.wrapUpIdle: Wrap-up starts when a call ends.
agent.wrapUpDuringCall: You can start the note now; the disposition waits for the call to end.
agent.callIdCopyFailed: Call ID not copied: press Ctrl+C (⌘C)

supervisor.forceLogoutConfirm: Sign {{name}} out? Their phone stops receiving calls immediately.

monitor.WHISPER: Whisper — heard by the agent only
monitor.LISTENHint: Your phone answers by itself and you hear both sides of {{name}}'s call. Nobody hears you.
monitor.WHISPERHint: Your phone answers by itself; {{name}} hears you, the customer does not.
monitor.BARGEHint: Your phone answers by itself and both {{name}} and the customer hear you.
monitor.yourPhoneHint: It rings your own phone. Starting another mode ends the one running — you never hang up first.

supervisor.name: Name
supervisor.queuesHint: Queues as configured, and who staffs each one.
supervisor.noQueueData: No calls in this window yet.
supervisor.slaHint: Calls answered within the queue threshold, as a share of all calls offered — unanswered calls stay in the denominator.

call.dtmfHint: Each key is sent to the other party as you press it.

admin.extensionsHint: Endpoints the switch accepts a registration for. A phone is created with the account it belongs to.
admin.deleteExtensionConfirm: Delete extension {{number}}? Its phone stops registering.
admin.passwordUnchangedHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
admin.routingHint: Queues and how they choose an agent. Changes reach the switch immediately.
admin.deleteQueueConfirm: Delete queue {{name}}? Callers can no longer be transferred to it.
admin.queueNameHint: Used by the switch; no spaces, @ or quotes.
admin.queueExtensionHint: Allocated from the queue pool when the queue was created. It cannot change: the switch and every routed call know the queue by it.
admin.overflowTargetHint: An extension to forward to, or the number that reaches the bot.
admin.numbersHint: Every number answers with a bot. The queue is only where a caller goes if the bot cannot take the call.
admin.deleteNumberConfirm: Delete number {{number}}? Calls to it will be rejected.
admin.languageHint: Sets the greeting, prompt language and voice for this number.
admin.fallbackQueueHint: This number's queue for people: where the bot transfers callers who ask for one, and where they go when the bot cannot take the call at all (provider outage, no capacity, gateway down).
admin.overviewHint: What is configured, and whether the parts you cannot see are alive.
admin.healthHint: A console that falls behind this sequence resynchronises from snapshots. A trunk is defined in the switch's own configuration; this reads its state.
admin.agentsHint: Who is an agent, and which phone they are bound to. An agent signs in at that extension and nowhere else.
admin.deleteAgentConfirm: Remove {{name}} as an agent? The account remains; it simply stops taking calls.
admin.accountHint: Only accounts without an agent identity are listed.
admin.noFreeUsers: Every account already has an agent identity.
admin.callcenterNameHint: The identifier the switch knows this agent by; no spaces, @ or quotes.
admin.boundExtensionHint: The extension this agent signs in at. An extension belongs to one agent.
admin.autoAnswerHint: Whether the phone picks up queue calls without the agent clicking answer.
admin.revealHint: Reading this is recorded in the audit trail. It is what the handset registers with.
admin.passwordNewHint: Generated, shown once, and gone when you leave this form. Copy it now.
admin.passwordMintedHint: Shown once only; leave the form and it is gone. Copy it now — it takes effect on save, and the old one stops working.
admin.passwordExistingHint: Not shown here. Copy reads it back and records that it was read; Reset replaces it and the old one stops working at once.
admin.directionHint: At least one of the two. A number that receives calls answers with a bot flow.
admin.isDefaultOutbound: Use as the default outbound number
admin.botFlowHint: What the bot says when somebody calls this number.
admin.noTrunks: none — the switch reports no gateway
admin.staffHint: Added and removed on the switch straight away; the next call is offered to this list.
admin.noneStaffed: Nobody yet. A call routed here has no one to go to.
admin.allStaffed: Every agent is already on this queue
admin.maxOutboundChannelsHint: How many outbound calls this number may carry at once, ringing and talking together. Leave empty for no limit.

cdr.noRecording: No recording was made for this call.
cdr.noTranscript: No transcript; the call never reached the bot.
cdr.noRecordHint: This call has no record in the ledger. Calls that never reached the switch, such as a skipped number, leave none.

callbacks.hint: Promises the bot made on the phone. Claim one before you ring.
callbacks.empty: Nothing to call back. The bot will fill this list.

reports.noQueueCalls: No queue calls in this window.
reports.slaHint: Calls answered within the queue threshold, as a share of all calls offered — unanswered calls stay in the denominator.

phone.noExtension: No extension is bound to your account
phone.readyBlocked: Your phone is not ready, so calls cannot be offered to you.

lost.title: Phone lost contact with this page
lost.text: The extension is installed and registered, but this page no longer reaches it. Reload the page to reconnect.

onboarding.title: Set up your phone
onboarding.subtitle: Calls ring in a Chrome extension. Three steps, once per browser.
onboarding.noExtensionId: Open the extension's options page from chrome://extensions

install.title: Install the phone extension
install.text: The extension holds the registration and the microphone; this page never does.

site.title: Allow this site
site.text: The extension only runs on sites you allow. Add {{host}}.

microphone.title: Allow the microphone
microphone.text: Chrome asks once. Without it a call connects with no audio.

myCalls.hint: Every call you have finished, newest first.
myCalls.empty: No calls yet. Yours will appear here as you finish them.

contacts.hint: Who a number belongs to, and what the last person who spoke to them noted.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.numberHint: How a caller is identified, so one number has one contact.
contacts.notesHint: Shown on the caller card during a call.
contacts.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Their calls stay in the ledger.

player.failed: The recording could not be loaded.

audit.hint: Every change that succeeded, newest first.

bots.hint: What the bot is and what it may do. Callers hear the published revision, never the draft.
bots.noFlows: No flows yet. `aicc flowadd` loads one from a file; New flow starts one here.
bots.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. It cannot be changed later — automation updates a flow by it.
bots.name: Name
bots.publishHint: Calls that start after this run the new revision. Calls in progress keep the one they started on.
bots.refusedPhases: This deployment's voice provider says only what it is given, so every phase a call does not leave needs its own announce line. These phases have none:
bots.publishBlocked_one: This revision can transfer the caller to a person, and {{count}} campaign that has not finished (Draft, Running or Paused) dials with this flow; a campaign call has no way to a person. Finish or cancel that campaign, or remove the transfer from the flow. Nothing was published.
bots.publishBlocked_other: This revision can transfer the caller to a person, and {{count}} campaigns that have not finished (Draft, Running or Paused) dial with this flow; a campaign call has no way to a person. Finish or cancel those campaigns, or remove the transfer from the flow. Nothing was published.
bots.unreachable: No transition reaches: {{nodes}}. The call can never get there.
bots.neverPublished: Never published — no number answers with this flow yet.
bots.restoreWarning: The draft becomes this revision's spec, and edits that are not saved and changes that are not published are lost. You confirm the publish in the next step; callers hear nothing new until then.
bots.restored: Revision {{id}} is now the draft. Publish it to put it live.
bots.restoreRefused: Rolling back to revision {{id}} was refused; the draft is unchanged.
bots.builtinTool: Built in — implemented by the platform, no HTTP call

builtin.transfer_to_agent: Hand the caller to a queue of people. Always allowed; may refuse when the queue is closed.
builtin.take_message: Record a callback request for an agent to return.
builtin.hangup: End the call once the caller is done.

users.hint: Who uses this product, and what each of them was given.
users.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen. The agent's switch-side name is derived from it and cannot be renamed afterwards.
users.roleHint: An agent or supervisor is given a phone from the extension pool; an administrator takes no calls and gets none.
users.statusHint: A suspended account is refused on its next request, not at its next sign-in.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Nothing can read it back; an administrator can only replace it.
users.resetHint: Every session opened with the old password is ended.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Where finished calls are sent, and whether they arrived. Subscriptions are created through the API; this page reads them.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.none: No subscriptions. Create one through the API.
webhooks.noDeliveries: Nothing has been sent to this subscriber yet.

keys.title: API Keys
keys.description: The credentials a system authenticates with. Each key holds exactly the capabilities it was issued with, and is revoked on its own.
keys.name: Name
keys.nameHint: What holds this key — the integration, not the person who set it up.
keys.scopesHint: Exactly what this key may do. A key with none authenticates and can reach nothing.
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? This cannot be undone — anything using it stops working at once, and a replacement is a new key.
keys.secretHint: This is the only time it is shown. It is stored as a digest, so nobody can produce it again — a lost key is revoked and reissued.

dnc.hint: Numbers the platform will never dial, by a campaign or by the bot. Removing one makes it dialable again.
dnc.removeConfirm: Remove {{number}}? It can be dialled again.

campaign.hint: AI outbound lists. Each answered call talks to the number's flow; follow-up is by callback.
campaign.newHint: A new campaign is a draft. Nothing is dialled until you start it.
campaign.name: Name

pauseReasons.TRUNK_FAILURE: Paused automatically: the trunk is failing
pauseReasons.PROVIDER_FAILURE: Paused automatically: the voice provider is failing
pauseReasons.OUTBOUND_NOT_CONFIGURED: Paused automatically: this deployment has no outbound endpoint

pauseExplain.MANUAL: No new calls are placed. Calls in progress finish normally.
pauseExplain.TRUNK_FAILURE: Too many calls failed to reach the carrier in a row. Nothing will resume this campaign by itself: check the trunk, then resume it.
pauseExplain.PROVIDER_FAILURE: Too many answered calls failed to start a bot session in a row. Nothing will resume this campaign by itself: check the voice provider, then resume it.
pauseExplain.OUTBOUND_NOT_CONFIGURED: The dialer found AICC_OUTBOUND_ENDPOINT empty, so no call could be placed. Set it to the dial string your carrier gateway takes (deploy/carrier.md) and recreate the app, then resume this campaign. Resuming is refused until it is set.

actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel {{name}}? No more calls will be placed and it cannot be started again. Calls in progress finish. Contacts and leads stay readable.
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete the draft {{name}} and its contacts? This cannot be undone.

campaign.systemFailures: Attempts that never reached the customer
campaign.noLeads: No leads with this intent yet.

form.name: Name
form.didHint: Only enabled numbers that allow outbound calls. Its published flow talks to every answered call, and must not offer a transfer to a person.
form.didReasonFlow: no published flow, or the flow can transfer to a person
form.rangeOutsideHours: {{ranges}} is outside the allowed calling hours {{hours}}.
form.outboundHoursHint: This deployment allows calls only within {{hours}}, in the contact's local time.
form.outOfLimits: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
form.defaultCountryCodeHint: Completes national numbers on import, digits without +.
form.followUpQueueHint: Where a high-intent lead's callback is filed.
form.timeZoneHint: IANA name. Applies to contacts that carry no zone of their own.
form.rangesHint: 24-hour HH:MM in the contact's local time. An end earlier than the start crosses midnight; 24:00 is allowed as an end.
form.maxConcurrentHint: This campaign's share of the deployment's concurrent calls.
form.useDefaultRetry: Use the deployment's default retry policy
form.maxAttemptsHint: Attempts that reached the customer, per contact.
form.maxSystemRetriesHint: Attempts that never reached the customer, per contact.
form.intervalHint: How long to wait before dialling again after an outcome that reached the customer.
form.backoffHint: Network errors and failed placements wait base times factor for each failure so far, up to the longest wait.
form.lockedHint: Locked while the campaign is running or paused. Only maximum concurrent calls, calling window and retry policy can change.
form.finishedHint: A finished campaign cannot be changed.

import.title: Import contacts
import.hint: Choose a CSV file or an Excel workbook. It is read in this browser and sent in requests of at most {{max}} rows. A number already on the campaign is reported as a duplicate, never added twice.
import.badEncoding: The file contains characters that are not valid UTF-8, so some text may be garbled. Save it as UTF-8 and choose it again.
import.unterminatedQuote: A quoted value is never closed; the rows after it may be merged into one.
import.xlsxFailed: This file could not be read as an Excel workbook. It may be damaged, or an older .xls file, which is not read here — open it in a spreadsheet and save it as .xlsx.
import.mappingHint: Pick the number column and, if the file has one, a time zone column. A column whose header names a field the campaign's flow reads is chosen for it already; every other column is ignored until you choose one of the flow's fields. A name the flow does not read makes its row fail.
import.noFlowFields: The flow behind this campaign reads no business-data fields, or its number has no published flow, so only the number and the time zone can be mapped.

problems.MANY_NUMBERS: Only one column can be the number.
problems.MANY_TIME_ZONES: Only one column can be the time zone.
problems.EMPTY_SLOT_NAME: A flow field needs a name.
problems.DUPLICATE_SLOT: Two columns have the same field name.

import.badShape_one: {{count}} row has a different number of columns than the header and will be rejected without being sent.
import.badShape_other: {{count}} rows have a different number of columns than the header and will be rejected without being sent.
import.failed: The import stopped at row {{row}}: {{reason}} Rows before it were handled; retrying sends the rest, and a number already added is reported as a duplicate.
import.moreProblems: {{count}} more not shown. Download the rejected rows to see them all.

codes.NUMBER_INVALID: Not a phone number the platform can read.
codes.SLOT_UNKNOWN: The flow does not read a field called {{detail}}.
codes.SLOT_TOO_LONG: The value of {{detail}} is longer than 256 characters.
codes.ROW_SHAPE: Wrong number of columns (found/expected {{detail}}); not sent.
